comment: The curated model list. Every URL is pinned to a commit of the Hugging Face repository (not 'main'), so the file at that URL never changes; sha256 and bytes are those of the file (verified against huggingface.co's own listing on 2026-10-15). A download is stored only if its size and sha256 match. To add a model: add an entry with its exact URL, sha256 and size; the app asks no host beyond huggingface.co and the CDN it redirects to (see vmapp.json).

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
models.note: The smallest one: fast on any Mac, good for trying the app. Simple answers only.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.note: Meta's small Llama (GGUF conversion by bartowski).

models.name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
models.note: A step up in quality; still comfortable on 4 vCPUs.

models.name: Qwen2.5 7B Instruct
models.note: Real quality, but 4.7 GB: slow on the CPU and bigger than the default VM memory. This is the model the Mac's GPU is for.
